editorial.blurb: Tierra y Fuego is a stunningly detailed steakhouse where exceptional food, impeccable service, and beautiful ambiance come together for truly memorable meals.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive when the restaurant isn't at peak capacity (avoid Valentine's Day and busy nights) to experience the full charm of the charismatic service and complimentary welcome drink that sets the tone for your evening.

topDishes.note: Perfectly tender with delicious flavor; a standout dinner highlight
